A '''battle''' of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] took place in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. After Galantos' inhabitants, the [[Fian/Legends|Fia]], made a deal with the [[Peace Brigade]] and informed them of the threat of the [[Yevetha]], the Peace Brigade relayed the information to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], who [[Destruction of N'zoth|attacked]] the Yevetha and drove them nearly to extinction.

Meanwhile, a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] team traveled to Galantos in hopes of reopening communications between Galantos and the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government. While there, however, the Yuuzhan Vong launched an assault on Galantos, hoping to capture [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. The Fian government ordered the military to not attack the Yuuzhan Vong, but the [[Twin Suns Squadron]] of the Galactic Alliance defended the planet, and eventually a Fian [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] squadrons of [[Galantos Guard]] launched in spite of the Fian government's orders and helped the Twin Suns [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] defeat the Yuuzhan Vong forces. After the destruction of the Yuuzhan Vong [[Slaveship|slave ship]] and the reconnection of communications between Galantos and the Galactic Alliance, the Fian government declared its loyalty to the Galactic Alliance.
